rationale: This S5 UI delta replaces the misleading language-only Settings page with four truthful interface controls. Language, five bounded 0.x-derived brightness levels and two semantic themes apply immediately and persist; sound remains visibly unavailable until HW-T09 can prove the GPIO2 buzzer/VBAT path. The test changes only UI/NVS/backlight behavior and leaves every RF, storage-session and safety-output path untouched.
required_host_checks: native controller bounds, invalid-value fallback and semantic-theme tests
EN/RU generated-font fit and UI source contracts
exact firmware build and resource budget
buzzer and radio transmit safety contracts remain unchanged
required_hil_scenarios: four-row Settings TFT in both themes with incremental selection and brightness redraw
language, brightness and theme survive a hardware reset
sound action remains unchanged and reports unavailable
original preferences are restored and survive a second reset
zero radio TX, input drops and final ownership
